premises.text: Small and retail businesses are frequently targeted for robberies, with many going unsolved
premises.evidence_span: In the U.S. last year alone, there were over 75,000 small and retail business robberies. That's over 200 a day, and over 70% of those go unsolved.

premises.text: Existing surveillance systems are passive and do not provide real-time assistance during crimes
premises.evidence_span: the store did have a dozen high-definition surveillance cameras, but these are passive devices, meaning they don't actually help you in the moment.

premises.text: Remote video monitoring services are too expensive for most small businesses
premises.evidence_span: while you can hire monitoring services to have people watch your store remotely, they're too expensive to be practical for most businesses.

premises.text: Deep Science AI can provide active threat detection using AI to monitor multiple camera feeds
premises.evidence_span: we've built a human-in-the-loop AI surveillance platform that can visually detect weapons, people wearing masks, and intruders after hours.

premises.text: The platform can alert human analysts in real-time when a threatening situation develops
premises.evidence_span: when a threatening situation develops, our analyst is alerted by our AI within fractions of a second.

premises.text: The platform can contact police immediately when a crime is detected
premises.evidence_span: If a crime is being committed, the police are contacted immediately as the crime is happening, not after.

premises.text: The market for remote video monitoring in small and retail businesses is significant
premises.evidence_span: we believe there are currently 750,000 small and retail business locations in the U.S. alone.

premises.text: Deep Science AI's platform is cost-effective compared to traditional human-only monitoring solutions
premises.evidence_span: their market is limited, because they're so expensive, to special customer use cases like car dealerships and construction lots.

value.text: Small businesses can achieve real-time security monitoring and threat detection affordably
value.evidence_span: makes remote video monitoring cost-effective for small businesses for the first time.
